payload.title: Safely inject array procedure parameters
payload.description:
As a procedure author, I want array-valued runtime parameters to reach Lua unchanged, so that exact scoped orchestration can execute safely.

Out of scope: changing parameter semantics or adding a second execution path.

Feature: Safe structured parameter injection

  Scenario: Inject an array into a YAML-backed procedure
    Given a Tactus procedure parameter contains a JSON-compatible array
    When Plexus injects the runtime context into Lua
    Then the Lua source parses successfully
    And the procedure receives the complete array unchanged

  Scenario: Preserve scalar parameter behavior
    Given existing scalar procedure parameters
    When Plexus injects the runtime context into Lua
    Then their values remain unchanged
